data.title: Delos Data Closes over $100 Million to Deliver Delos Nonstop AI™ for Faster, Stronger, More Efficient AI Capacity
data.description: A California-based company, Delos Data, revealed on September 15, 2026, that they have successfully secured more than $100 million in funding. The substantial investment was contributed by several prominent backers including Matrix, Playground, Socratic Partners, Capricorn's Technology Impact Fund, Matter Venture Partners, and IAG, alongside key figures in the fields of compute, hyperscale, and scalability.

data.title: Spectrum Investment Advisors Welcomes New Team Members, earns 2026 Best Places to Work Recognition
data.description: On September 15, 2026, in Mequon, Wisconsin, Spectrum Investment Advisors revealed two new team members and was recognized as a leading employer in the Milwaukee region. Tricia Sendelbach became the Senior Relationship Manager at Spectrum, bolstering the team's capabilities. This further cements Spectrum's reputation as a top employer in Milwaukee.
